name: paged-docs
description: idml.paged.media (the IDML reference) and docs.paged.media (the Paged docs), one Fumadocs app built twice (SITE=idml|paged).

scripts.dev: pnpm generate:docs && node scripts/write-redirects.mjs && node scripts/stage-verified.mjs && pnpm -s examples:assemble > /dev/null && node scripts/stage-downloads.mjs && next dev
scripts.generate:docs: node scripts/generate/pull-sources.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-matrix.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-scripting.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-cli.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-surfaces.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-plugin-sdk.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-api.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-activity.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-sdk.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-idml-schema.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-idml-reference.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-crosslinks.mjs && node scripts/generate/gen-facts.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm generate:docs && node scripts/write-redirects.mjs && node scripts/stage-verified.mjs && pnpm -s examples:assemble > /dev/null && node scripts/stage-downloads.mjs && pnpm prepare:preview && next build
